text:
Nora Blake: quick review: added a 'Replay' control to rollout timeline. main asks: SR announce brevity, rollforward copy, and colorblind-friendly lanes. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/replay/new-timeline
Hassan Ali: neat feature. SR concern: don't flood with messages during play. add a user toggle: 'Announce steps' ON/OFF. default OFF.
June Park: good. when OFF, only visual animation; when ON, announce each step with a short phrase. examples?
A11yBot: suggested SR phrases (keep very short):
"Replay: step 2 of 6  Apr 14, 2026  Canary A +10% (canary)"
"Replay: step 5 of 6  Apr 12, 2026  Reverted to v2.1 (reverted)"
June Park: nice. also for manual scrubber we should emit single-line announcements: "History: Apr 14, 2026  Canary A +10% (canary)"
Hassan Ali: copy: context menu should show short verbs 'Rollback' and 'Roll forward'. confirm dialogs should be explicit: title 'Confirm roll forward', body 'Make v3.0 live for all traffic? Audit note (optional):', primary 'Roll forward'.
Nora Blake: agreed. PM asked to keep menu word short and modal explicit. will mock both.
A11yBot: aria details: use aria-live="polite" for announcements, set aria-atomic=true for the region, and include a visually-hidden status token per checkpoint (e.g., '(canary)', '(reverted)'). For delta changes announce: 'Allocation changed: Canary A +5%'.
June Park: UX: when user triggers rollforward show ephemeral banner 'Rolled forward to v3.0  Undo' with 20s timeout. Undo should be keyboard-focusable and announced with role='status' but not steal focus.
Hassan Ali: ensure banner doesn't trap focus. if user invoked via keyboard shortcut, offer initial focus on Undo. otherwise announce only.
June Park: colorblindness: add letter prefix on variant pills (A/B) and patterned border option in settings. also ensure active pill border meets contrast.
A11yBot: variant labels: show human-friendly short label on pill and full model slug in tooltip/flyout. tooltip content must be keyboard-expandable (Enter) not hover-only.
Nora Blake: mobile: compact history collapses to stacked items under 360px. touch targets >=44px. slider only accepts integer percentages; helper text: 'Traffic allocation accepts whole percentages only.'
Hassan Ali: delta announce when allocation changes: 'Allocation changed: Canary A +5%'. keep under 5 words after the variant.
PreviewBot: preview deployed for branch 'replay-ui' at sha c3d9ef  https://preview.redwood.dev/replay-ui
June Park: I'll update Figma frames with announce toggle, modal copy, and pill prefixes. tagging @Hassan @Nora for final signoff.
